name: Catacombs of the Damned
summary: A free Arduboy dungeon crawler with randomly generated floors and monsters.

notes: Reviewed 2026-11-03 under ADR 0012. Original publisher release 1.0 resolves to c888154575bb61a8d5126e84cca24bb29d609724. The .arduboy asset is a ZIP container, not a new archive format. No publisher checksum is available; Store-pinned size and SHA-256 trust the publisher's GitHub HTTPS download at review time, not independent publisher authentication. No Nursery or PortMaster asset is used.

ZIP inventory: five regular files, 84934 bytes: Arduboy3D.hex, banner.png, info.json, screen1.png and screen2.png. No links, special entries, duplicates or unsafe paths. All files are copied unchanged; Arduboy3D.hex is mapped to Catacombs.hex for a distinct save basename. Main HEX SHA-256: 3f024b048c4137c6cc86bf36ff5f2146bd7c352f85c20e6d815c40b0e2980eeb. The game's code and original sprite data are covered by the publisher repository's MIT licence. Its description says inspired by Catacomb 3D; it does not require commercial data or BIOS files.

KNULLI distribution ab3a6809286b3cff1648fb8c96a0200bc869beb6 declares arduboy with HEX support and the Arduous core. Its recipe pins libretro/arduous 2273b485628790a2ce954941341b5b071c3fb30e and installs /usr/lib/libretro/arduous_libretro.so. The core reads Intel HEX, exposes EEPROM through RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM and maps the RetroPad controls. Require both firmware RetroArch and Arduous; do not install an emulator. AArch64/glibc describe the KNULLI host, not the Arduboy ROM CPU.

Store writes only the private /userdata/roms/arduboy/Catacombs directory, its exact entry in /userdata/roms/arduboy/gamelist.xml, and normal Store state. KNULLI configgen uses /userdata/saves/arduboy for RetroArch saves/states. Runtime-created files, local fallback saves and shared saves/settings are unowned and survive Repair/removal. No shared firmware or PortMaster path is claimed. Close the game before operations. No runtime downloads, updater or network client are in this ROM. Fixture checks are not physical-device gameplay or completed save/load evidence.
